primitives.name: Phase Space Flow
primitives.verbatim_quote: Among other things, we track every champion's location multiple times every second.
primitives.assumptions: Champion positions are sampled at fixed intervals with negligible latency.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When champions overlap or are occluded by terrain.

layer2.mapping: Each champion's trajectory maps to a particle in a 3D phase space where position and momentum evolve according to game physics.

primitives.name: Action Sequence Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: In addition to the location data, we also track every ability cast, every attack made, and the damages caused and avoided.
primitives.assumptions: Actions are atomic and timestamped with sub-second resolution.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When actions are concurrent or ambiguous in causality.

layer2.mapping: Sequence of actions forms a kernel in action space, enabling convolution-based temporal pattern recognition.
layer2.telemetry: Accuracy of action classification and timing precision.

primitives.name: Vision State Matrix
primitives.verbatim_quote: We track the amount of actual vision granted and denied in the fog of war.
primitives.assumptions: Vision is binary between teams and updated per game tick.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When fog of war transitions are non-deterministic or delayed.

layer2.mapping: Matrix entries represent visibility relationships between players; models information asymmetry akin to sensor networks.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of map visibility covered per team per interval.

reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight is that traditional eSports analytics rely on sparse, event-driven API logs which encode only outcomes rather than processes. By contrast, optical tracking enables dense, continuous monitoring of player behavior, yielding a rich phase-space representation of gameplay dynamics. The phase space flow primitive captures positional evolution, while the action sequence kernel encodes tactical decisions through ability usage and damage metrics. Vision state matrix introduces a strategic layer by modeling information asymmetry. These primitives form a dual framework: one describing motion and interaction (flow), another encoding intent and cognition (kernel). Failure modes arise from occlusion, latency, and misclassification of actions. The system's robustness hinges on real-time processing pipelines that maintain consistency under these adversarial conditions.
